verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order: a big stacked headline, then the blue date box, then the black box. Its flaws are left edges that don't line up (headline at about x=22, blue box at about x=30, black box at about x=50), a dead band at the top and a large gap above the black box. B puts the blue date box above the headline, so the reading order is wrong. B's headline is shrunk and wraps badly, leaving 'FESTIVAL' alone on the last line. Its box copy is tiny and its boxes sit at different indents with no shared axis.
